text: dsh-team-flow-continuous 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams 的团队协作插件，让主代理等待队友期间仍可接收用户 Steer。它扩展 wait_agent 的结果契约，并识别同一 Lead 收到的用户插话来结束当前这一次等待；AgentLoop 随后可领取原消息，队友继续工作。插件复用官方 Team 工具，保留 Queue、普通发送、停止和超时等既有语义，适合需要在并行任务运行时补充要求或调整方向的用户。需要先启用官方 Agent Teams，并使用兼容版本的 DSH 与 Node.js。

dsh-team-flow-continuous lets a DSH Agent Teams user steer the Lead during a wait. The wait ends and the native loop receives the message while teammates keep working. It adapts wait_agent and preserves Queue behavior. Requires official Agent Teams, compatible DSH, and Node.js 24+.
想在主代理等队友返回结果时补充一条要求。
能不能插话让正在等待的 Lead 继续处理我的消息？
队友还在并行干活时，我想调整主任务方向。
让 DSH 的 Agent Teams 等待期间也能接收用户指令。
主代理卡在 wait_agent 时，怎么只结束这一次等待？
希望给 Lead 发 Steer，但不打断队友正在做的事。
Let me redirect the team lead while parallel teammates keep working.
How can I send a user steer during an Agent Teams wait?
dsh-team-flow-continuous 的功能「wait-steer」：用户在同一 Lead 的 wait_agent 等待期间发送 Steer 时，插件结束当前这一轮等待并让原生循环领取原消息；队友不会因此停止。
dsh-team-flow-continuous 的功能「scope」：插件只将同一 Agent 收到的用户消息作为唤醒信号；其他来源的消息及不匹配的 Lead 不会触发该等待逻辑。
dsh-team-flow-continuous 的功能「preserve-tools」：插件在注册 wait_agent 时扩展可接受的结果 schema，并为用户插话结果提供专用呈现；其他结果仍交给原呈现逻辑。
dsh-team-flow-continuous 的功能「unload」：插件停用时会中止由它管理的当前等待、恢复装饰过的方法，并等待这些等待流程收束。

text:
dsh-team-flow-continuous README · 团队继续做，你也能补充要求：多代理并行工作、Lead 正在等待结果时，使用 **Steer / 插话** 补充要求或调整方向。主代理继续接收你的消息，队友手头的任务继续运行；Queue 和普通发送保持原有行为。

| 输入 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 同一 Lead 的用户 Steer | 结束本次等待，让原生循环继续领取消息 |
| Queue、普通 send、inject | 保留各自语义，不当作 Steer |
| 其他会话或队友输入 | 不直接结束这里的 Lead 等待 |
| Stop、guard、Team 变化、timeout | 保留原有结果 |

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · 安装与更新：需要 **DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2、Node >=24**，并先启用官方 **Agent Teams**。当前持续验证 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 / alpha.2 / rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.4 / 0.2.2-rc.1；详细范围见[验证记录](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow/blob/main/docs/verification.md)。

在市场搜索 **dsh-team-flow**，确认来源 **jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow**。npm 包与 GitHub 源都包含预构建文件，无需批准安装脚本。市场识别 npm 包后会优先使用 npm；已有源安装也可检查版本更新。npm 默认通道为正式版本。

1. 等所有 Agent 空闲，备份自己的 profile；建议使用测试 profile。
2. 启用官方 Agent Teams，然后安装本插件：

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · 安装与更新：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <test-profile> add dsh-team-flow-continuous --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
```

3. 确认本插件排在 Agent Teams bundle **之后**。按宿主要求重启，再开新会话，使用 Steer / 插话。

再次执行安装命令可更新。之前安装旧版 `.tgz` 的用户可用同一 profile 执行此命令切换到 npm 源，之后再由市场检查更新。Enter 是否执行 Steer 取决于 DSH 发送设置。

<details>
<summary>安装顺序、停用与卸载</summary>

插件声明了 bundle 顺序，但不会替你启用 Agent Teams。它停用原 `tool-agent-team` entry，加载宿主自身的官方工具，避免重复注册。自定义过 `freshProvider` / `forkProvider` 的用户应在本插件配置里保留相同值。

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · 安装与更新：请使用市场的**包级开关**或卸载，恢复完整补丁层；不要只停用 loader entry，否则可能留下对官方工具的停用。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <test-profile> remove dsh-team-flow-continuous
```

等待 Agent 空闲后再停用或卸载。活动 wait 被停用时会返回 `TEAM_FLOW_RC2_DISABLED`；未捕获它的 PTC 程序可能停止后续语句。

</details>

更新由市场检查并在你点击后安装，不会静默后台升级；需要时按提示重启 DSH。

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · 兼容边界：- 使用可恢复的运行时方法装饰，复用宿主 Team 工具；没有修改宿主源码或安装文件。
- 不取消 Agent、不消费或重发 Inbox 消息。成功值为 `{timedOut:false, reason:'user-steer'}`，不是伪造 timeout。
- 方法装饰不是专用官方扩展 hook；其他装饰器、缓存方法或 ABI 变化可能冲突。不支持的契约在可检测时保留原等待并告警，模块不兼容也可能加载失败。
- `user Steer` 表示经 `Agent.steer()` 投递的 user 消息，不认证第三方调用是否来自真人。
- 不保证未经测试的新版本始终兼容，也不代表上游已合并修复。隔离 Mock 测试不等于真实模型效果或生产延迟。

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · Team Flow：Team Flow is an Agent Teams steering plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). A same-session user can **Steer** the Lead while it is waiting in `wait_agent`, ending that one wait so the native AgentLoop can consume the original message. Teammates continue working and Queue retains its semantics.

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · Add a requirement while the team works：When the Lead is waiting for parallel tasks, send a Steer to add a requirement or redirect the task. The Lead can receive your message while teammates continue their work. Queue and normal sends keep their original behavior.

text:
dsh-team-flow-continuous README · Add a requirement while the team works：| Input | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Same Lead's user Steer | Ends this wait, allowing native message delivery to continue |
| Queue, generic send, inject | Keep their own semantics; do not count as Steer |
| Other Session or teammate input | Does not directly end this Lead's wait |
| Stop, guards, Team changes, timeout | Keep their native outcomes |

text: dsh-team-flow-continuous README · Install and update：Requires **DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 and Node >=24**, with official **Agent Teams** enabled first. CI covers DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 / alpha.2 / rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.4 / 0.2.2-rc.1. See the [verification matrix](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow/blob/main/docs/verification.md).

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · Install and update：Search for **dsh-team-flow**, source **jidekaixin2dian/dsh-team-flow**, in the marketplace. npm and GitHub installs include prebuilt files and need no install-script approval. The catalog prefers npm once mapped; source installs also support version checks. The default npm channel serves stable releases.

1. Wait for all Agents to become idle, back up your profile and preferably use a test profile.
2. Enable official Agent Teams, then install:

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · Install and update：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <test-profile> add dsh-team-flow-continuous --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
```

3. Keep this bundle **after** Agent Teams. Restart if requested, open a new conversation and use Steer.

Run the same command to update. Existing `.tgz` installations can run it in the same profile to switch to the npm source for future marketplace update checks. Enter's behavior depends on DSH's send settings.

<details>
<summary>Ordering, disabling and removal</summary>

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · Install and update：Bundle ordering metadata does not enable Agent Teams. This plugin disables the stock `tool-agent-team` entry and loads the host's own tool module, avoiding duplicate owners. Preserve custom `freshProvider` / `forkProvider` values in this plugin's configuration.

Use the marketplace's **package switch** or uninstall to remove the whole patch layer. Disabling only the loader entry can leave stock tools disabled.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <test-profile> remove dsh-team-flow-continuous
```

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · Install and update：Operate while Agents are idle. Disabling an active wait returns `TEAM_FLOW_RC2_DISABLED`; uncaught PTC code may stop subsequent statements.

</details>

The marketplace checks versions and installs after your click; it does not silently upgrade in the background. Restart DSH when requested.

dsh-team-flow-continuous README · Compatibility boundaries：- Reversible runtime decorators reuse the host's own Team tools without patching host source or installation files.
- The plugin does not cancel Agents, consume Inbox messages or resend input. Its successful wake result is `{timedOut:false, reason:'user-steer'}`, not a fabricated timeout.
- Decorated methods are not dedicated extension hooks. Other decorators, cached methods or ABI changes can conflict. Detectable unsupported contracts retain native waiting with a warning; module incompatibility may prevent loading.
- User Steer means a user message delivered through `Agent.steer()`, not authentication that a third-party caller is human.
- Future host compatibility is not guaranteed and this is not an upstream-merged fix. Isolated Mock checks do not establish real-model behavior or production latency.
